# ScribeCat 0.25.18

This release contains the final PDF and split-view fixes that were merged after the original 0.25.17 release tag.

### PDF viewer
- Fit the complete PDF page in the inline editor and fullscreen viewport at base zoom, including on mobile.
- Cancel and clear the selectable text layer when entering multi-page overview so page text cannot leak behind thumbnails.
- Keep multi-page view at the same viewer height and center the overview vertically.
- Adapt the number of visible thumbnails to the available width and height, then page through the remaining PDF pages.
- Gray out the normal single-page pager while multi-page overview is active.
- Use the mobile-style two-row PDF toolbar in narrow desktop split panes.
- Make mobile fullscreen edge-to-edge.
- Fit tall/portrait PDFs fully inside the screen with black side bars instead of cropping.
- Right-click a PDF to download/save the original document.

### Editor
- Use two stable toolbar rows when desktop split view is narrow.

### Server and Docker
- Release metadata and Compose defaults are updated to 0.25.18.
- Publish the exact multi-architecture server image as `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.18`.
